name: Discrete k-d tree isosurface extraction
definition: Extracts an isosurface from a scalar field by traversing a discrete k-d tree hierarchy along contour edges, refining nodes until contouring leaves are found, then generating quads.
summary: Discrete k-d tree isosurface extraction extracts isosurfaces by traversing a hierarchical k-d tree along contour edges, differing from standard marching cubes by enabling adaptive resolution and handling complex topologies.
